# algolia_composition (Data Source)

Use this data source to read an Algolia composition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algolia_composition" "example" {
  object_id = "featured-products"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `object_id` (String) Unique identifier of the composition.

### Read-Only

- `behavior` (String) JSON-encoded composition behavior (`injection` or `multifeed`).
- `description` (String) Composition description.
- `id` (String) The composition's unique identifier. Same value as `object_id`.
- `name` (String) Composition name.
- `sorting_strategy` (String) JSON-encoded map of sorting labels to the indices/replicas that implement them.
